title: Dein Weg zur DW&PM-Nachschreibeklausur
section: 3. Rechenkarte: das musst du ohne Vorlage können
text:
3. Rechenkarte: das musst du ohne Vorlage können
CPM: Vorwärts: ES = größtes EF aller Vorgänger; EF = ES + Dauer. Rückwärts: LF = kleinstes LS aller Nachfolger; LS = LF − Dauer. Gesamtpuffer = LS − ES. Am Projektende mit der zuvor berechneten Projektdauer beginnen. Bei mehreren Endknoten einen gemeinsamen Endpunkt beachten. Mehrere kritische Pfade sind möglich.
EVM: CV = EV − AC; SV = EV − PV; CPI = EV / AC; SPI = EV / PV. Negative CV = Kostenüberschreitung für die erbrachte Leistung, negative SV = Rückstand in Wertgrößen, nicht direkt in Tagen. Bei Null im Nenner ist der Index nicht definiert.
EAC: Die Annahme entscheidet. Einmalige, künftig nicht wiederkehrende Abweichung: EAC = AC + (BAC − EV). Bleibt die bisherige Kosteneffizienz bestehen: EAC = BAC / CPI. Nicht ohne Prüfung die Formeln austauschen.
EMV: Pro Alternative alle möglichen Ausgänge mit konsistenten Vorzeichen und demselben Zeitraum erfassen. Erwartungswert = Summe aus Wahrscheinlichkeit × Ergebnis. Bei reinen Kosten den kleineren Wert bevorzugen. Gemeinsame Anfangskosten nur einmal addieren; bedingte Wahrscheinlichkeiten entlang eines Pfads multiplizieren. EMV allein bildet Risikoaversion und Extremrisiken nicht ab.


Zusätzlicher eigener Rechendrill mit Lösung

PV = 200, EV = 150, AC = 180, BAC = 400. Berechne CV, SV, CPI, SPI und EAC unter beiden oben genannten Annahmen.
Abgeleitete Lösung: CV = −30; SV = −50; CPI ≈ 0,8333; SPI = 0,75. Über Budget für die erbrachte Leistung und hinter dem Plan. EAC bei einmaliger Abweichung = 180 + 250 = 430; bei fortgesetzter Kosteneffizienz = 400 / (150/180) = 480.
Englische Interpretation: “The project is over budget for the work performed and behind schedule. If current cost efficiency persists, the estimated total cost is 480.”

text:
4. Englisch antworten: Operator vor Textmenge

Name: geforderte Begriffe präzise nennen.
Define/describe: Bedeutung und wesentliche Merkmale ausdrücken.
Explain/apply: Zusammenhang erklären und konkrete Fallinformation verwenden.
Discuss/evaluate: relevante Argumente abwägen, Grenzen nennen, begründet urteilen.

Schreibgerüst für eine Fallantwort:

“The relevant concept is … It means … In this case, … Therefore, … However, … I recommend … because …”

Das Gerüst an Operator und verfügbare Punkte anpassen; keine unnötigen fünf Absätze bei einer kurzen Definitionsfrage.

title: Dein Weg zur DW&PM-Nachschreibeklausur
text:
5. Echte Generalprobe

Im Trainer Quelle Mock Exam wählen: 20 Teilaufgaben, zusammen 120 Punkte. Zugehöriges Originalblatt verwenden.
120 Minuten stellen, Lösungen geschlossen lassen und auf Englisch schreiben. Erlaubte Hilfsmittel vorher anhand der aktuellen Prüfungsankündigung klären.
Anschließend mit den verlinkten offiziellen Beispielantworten vergleichen. Unsere Kriterien sind kein offizielles Bewertungsraster.
Jeden Fehler einordnen: Begriff / Methode / Rechnung / Fallbezug / Englisch / Zeit.
Am nächsten Tag die fehlerhaften Aufgaben erneut ohne Vorlage lösen. Eine Transferfrage beantworten, damit nicht nur die Musterlösung hängen bleibt.

Der zusätzliche Practice Test ist eine selbst erstellte Übung, nicht das offizielle Mock Exam. Zuerst das Original-Mock nutzen.

title: DWPM Core Sheet
text:
A project is a temporary endeavor with a beginning and end, created to produce a unique product, service, result, business value, or organizational change.
A stakeholder is any individual, group, or organization that may affect, be affected by, or perceive itself as affected by a project decision, activity, or outcome.



The Magic Triangle consists of scope, time or schedule, and cost. These dimensions are interdependent. Increasing scope without changing time or cost creates pressure on quality or feasibility.
SMART goals are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound.




Initiating.
Planning.
Executing.
Monitoring and controlling.
Closing.




Scope management includes planning scope, collecting requirements, defining scope, creating the WBS, validating scope, and controlling scope.
Scope creep is uncontrolled change without proper adjustment to schedule, cost, or resources.



Critical path means the path with zero slack that determines the minimum project duration.
Earned value formulas:

CV = EV - AC
SV = EV - PV
CPI = EV / AC
SPI = EV / PV

Interpretation:

CPI > 1: cost efficient.
SPI < 1: behind schedule.




Risk management means identifying risks, analyzing probability and impact, planning responses, and monitoring them.
Expected monetary value is probability multiplied by monetary outcome.
Knowledge management includes knowledge integration and knowledge sharing. Typical challenges are tacit knowledge, fragmented tools, low incentives, turnover, time pressure, and trust.

title: DWPM Core Sheet
text:
Digital Work

Decision Making
Decision making is selecting one option among alternatives through reasoning and judgment. Bounded rationality means humans satisfice because time, knowledge, and cognitive capacity are limited.
Simon model:

Intelligence.
Design.
Choice.
Implementation.



Communication And Collaboration
Media Richness Theory says rich media fit equivocal tasks because they provide immediate feedback, multiple cues, personalization, and natural language.
The 3C collaboration model:

Communication.
Coordination.
Cooperation.

The cooperative work framework uses direct communication, shared understanding, artifacts of work, control, and feedback.


Hybrid Teams
The time-space matrix combines same or different place with same or different time. Hybrid teams need explicit awareness routines so people know who is doing what, where, when, and with which artifact.


Agility
Plan-based methods optimize predictability through upfront planning. Agile methods optimize learning through short iterations and customer feedback.
Scrum roles:

Product Owner maximizes value and prioritizes the backlog.
Scrum Master protects the process and removes impediments.
Development Team creates increments.



AI At The Workplace
Automation replaces human work steps. Augmentation enhances human abilities while humans remain responsible. Delegation assigns tasks to AI while humans keep accountability for goals and consequences.
Copilot is best framed as augmentation or human-AI collaboration. In security-relevant software development, review, testing, accountability, and policy matter more than maximum automation.


People Analytics And Algorithmic Management
People analytics is the computational use of employee or organizational data to inform decisions. Algorithmic management uses algorithms to support or perform management functions such as allocation, monitoring, evaluation, nudging, or sanctioning.
High-yield risks:

Opacity.
Privacy invasion.
Bias.
Nudging.
Stress.
Autonomy loss.
Accountability gaps.

Mitigation:

Transparency and inverse transparency.
Ombudsperson.
Clear usage rules.
Audits.
Human review.
Appeal channels.

A project has PV = 120, EV = 100, and AC = 80.

Reveal: Task 3 interpretation

CV = 20, SV = -20, CPI = 1.25, and SPI = 0.83. The project is under budget but behind schedule, so the answer must not say the project is simply “good”.



Which answer pattern is strongest for Digital Work essay tasks?

 Define the concept, explain the mechanism, apply it to evidence, name one risk, conclude.  List every keyword from the slides as quickly as possible.  Write a personal opinion first and add definitions only if time remains. Check

title: DWPM Concept Wiki
text:
Magic Triangle
The Magic Triangle connects scope, time, and cost. Changing one side usually affects at least one other side, so exam answers should not treat project targets as independent.






Note



Exam move: name the three dimensions, explain the dependency, then apply it to a concrete change request.




Self-check: explain it in one sentence

If scope increases while deadline and budget stay fixed, quality, workload, or feasibility comes under pressure because scope, time, and cost constrain each other.

title: DWPM Concept Wiki
text:
Critical Path
The critical path is the sequence of activities with zero slack. Delay on this path delays the whole project unless resources, scope, or dependencies change.


Which statement is most exam-ready?

 The critical path is the longest-looking path in the diagram.  The critical path determines minimum project duration because its activities have zero slack.  The critical path contains the most expensive activities. Check

title: DWPM Concept Wiki
text:
Earned Value
Earned value combines planned value, earned value, and actual cost. The formula is only half the answer; the interpretation earns the marks.



Formula
Meaning




CV = EV - AC
Cost variance.


SV = EV - PV
Schedule variance.


CPI = EV / AC
Cost efficiency.


SPI = EV / PV
Schedule performance.





Reveal: PV 120, EV 100, AC 80

CV = 20, SV = -20, CPI = 1.25, SPI = 0.83. The project is under budget but behind schedule.

title: DWPM Concept Wiki
text:
People Analytics
People analytics uses employee or organizational data to inform decisions. Good answers pair benefits with risks: opacity, privacy invasion, bias, stress, autonomy loss, and accountability gaps.


Which safeguard best matches inverse transparency?

 Let management collect more data without explanation.  Hide analytics models from employees to avoid confusion.  Let employees inspect and understand data flows that affect them. Check

title: DWPM Concept Wiki
text:
Agentic Coding
Agentic coding is software work where an AI agent plans, edits, runs tools, and iterates with human supervision. In DWPM terms, it is not automatically full automation: it often mixes augmentation and delegation.






Tip



Exam bridge: use agentic coding to discuss human-AI collaboration, accountability, review, skill shifts, and risk controls.




Reveal: augmentation or delegation?

If the human remains responsible and reviews the result, agentic coding is best described as augmentation or bounded delegation, not unmanaged automation.
